packageRules.description: pg-compat/Cargo.toml's pg-core-0-6-5 and pg-core-0-5-10 are `=`-exact, aliased (package = "pg-core") pins on the wire-compat gate's published readers, moved deliberately under the one-pin-per-minor-line rule (no_two_pinned_readers_share_a_minor_line in pg-compat/tests/support_window.rs). postguard-e2e's check-reader-rows.mjs watches their currency. The preset's fleet-wide first-party rule already covers pg-core; this repo-level rule is belt and braces, and it is the one pg-core/tests/renovate_config.rs pins.
